# Serial Installment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SerialInstallment`](gmeow-SerialInstallment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SerialInstallment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A single issue, episode, or chapter of a serial creative work — a comic issue, TV episode, magazine issue, or serial chapter. An out-of-universe publication artifact distinct from the narrative frame it sources. A specialization of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SerialInstallment`](gmeow-SerialInstallment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for one published installment of a serial — a comic issue, TV episode, magazine issue, or serial chapter at the [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md) tier.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the ongoing serial work as a whole (use [`gmeow:SerialWork`](gmeow-SerialWork.md)) and avoid conflating it with the in-universe narrative frame it sources (link by [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md)).

### How to use

- Type the installment [`gmeow:SerialInstallment`](gmeow-SerialInstallment.md), attach it to its [`gmeow:SerialWork`](gmeow-SerialWork.md) via the part spine, carry [`gmeow:datePublished`](../properties/gmeow-datePublished.md), and link the narrative frame it sources via [`gmeow:sourceFor`](../properties/gmeow-sourceFor.md).

### Examples

- ex:episode5 a [`gmeow:SerialInstallment`](gmeow-SerialInstallment.md); [`gmeow:partOf`](../properties/gmeow-partOf.md) ex:serialWork; [`gmeow:datePublished`](../properties/gmeow-datePublished.md) "2023-10-01T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
